sources_quoted.source: data/items.json - exhaustive scan of every passive/active branch for amplifier language
sources_quoted.text: Abyssal Mask's Unmake is the ONLY damage amplifier in the cache whose text names a damage type ('increased magic damage'). Every other amp in the cache (Imperial Mandate, Riftmaker, Liandry's Torment, Haunting Guise, Lord Dominik's Regards, Perplexity, Immortal Path, Diamond-Tipped Spear, Reinforced Armor) says 'increased damage' with no type restriction.
sources_quoted.reading: The magic-only restriction is a one-off in the item cache, i.e. exactly the property a generic 'amp multiplier' path is liable to drop.

sources_quoted.source: docs/math-foundations.md Sec. 1.2 / Sec. 2.1 / audit table row 'Resistance mitigation'
sources_quoted.text: the mitigation operator `x -> x*100/(100+R)` is *linear in raw damage* for a fixed resistance ... m(R) = 100 / (100 + R)
sources_quoted.reading: Because mitigation is linear in raw damage, a constant amplifier factor commutes with mitigation. Therefore an 'amp applied pre- vs post-mitigation' ordering change can NEVER move this leaf; only the presence/absence (or count) of an amplifier factor can. That is what licenses the pure factor analysis below.

step_4_wiki_adjudication.claim: Under the cached wiki text there is no configuration in which this event may carry the extra x1.12 that 234.2 contains.
why: If the event's damage is NOT magic (physical or true), Unmake does not apply at all - its text restricts it to 'magic damage' - while Mandate's Vulnerable still does ('damage they take from all sources'). Correct value = base * 1.07 = 209.1.

If the event's damage IS magic and one roster ally carries Abyssal Mask, the curse contributes exactly one x1.12. The wiki describes a binary state ('become cursed'), and the passive is flagged unique: true, so a second holder in the roster adds no second factor. A value carrying two curse factors is therefore unsupported. Correct value = base * 1.07 * 1.12 with a single-count base = 209.1.
The only way to reach 234.2 is to apply the magic-only curse to a damage type it excludes, or to apply the unique aura curse twice - neither of which the cached wiki text sanctions.

confidence.verified: The factor structure: the leaf moved by exactly one Abyssal Mask 'Unmake' x1.12, with Imperial Mandate's x1.07 untouched. All competing amp-composition hypotheses (additive stacking, strongest-wins, Mandate dropped) are numerically excluded.
confidence.not_verified: The absolute base damage (195.42) could not be recomputed from first principles: the scenario's champion/level/roster/target definition lives outside data/ (scripts/ + tests/), which this oracle is forbidden to read. The scenario name is not present anywhere in the data/ export.
confidence.flip_condition: The verdict would flip only if the engine now refuses an ALLY-held Abyssal Mask's curse on a genuinely magic-damage event. That would contradict the item text's explicit 'from all sources' clause - and it is not the shape of the observed delta, since it would have to strip the curse from every magic event in the ledger while the Mandate 7% (equally ally-held, equally 'from all sources') survives. A selective drop that keeps the type-agnostic amp and removes the type-restricted one is precisely the wiki-prescribed behaviour for a non-magic event.
